name: clickscope
description: Read-only ClickHouse access for any deployment — self-hosted, clustered or Cloud. Explore schemas, and cost a query with EXPLAIN ESTIMATE before running it so a full scan is caught before it starts. Ships query-craft guidance alongside the MCP server.

CLICKHOUSE_HOST.title: ClickHouse host
CLICKHOUSE_HOST.description: Hostname or IP, without a scheme or port. Leave empty if you set a profiles file below.

CLICKHOUSE_USER.title: Username
CLICKHOUSE_USER.description: Use an account granted only SELECT. ClickScope never writes, but the database is the layer that can actually enforce that.

CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD.title: Password
CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD.description: Stored in your system keychain, never written to a settings file. Leave empty for a server with no password.

CLICKHOUSE_DATABASE.title: Default database
CLICKHOUSE_DATABASE.description: Used when a tool call does not name one.

CLICKHOUSE_SECURE.title: Use HTTPS
CLICKHOUSE_SECURE.description: Enable for ClickHouse Cloud and any TLS-terminated endpoint.

CLICKSCOPE_PROFILES.title: Profiles file (optional, for several clusters)
CLICKSCOPE_PROFILES.description: Path to a JSON file describing multiple clusters. When set, it takes precedence over the single-cluster fields above. See the README for the format.

CLICKSCOPE_AUDIT_LOG.title: Audit log (optional)
CLICKSCOPE_AUDIT_LOG.description: Path to a JSONL file recording every query decision — allowed, blocked, rows read. Left empty, no audit trail is kept.
